# clerk_domain (Resource)

Manages a domain on a Clerk application via the Platform API. The Platform API is a beta feature that must be enabled by Clerk — contact Clerk support or visit your dashboard to request access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_domain" "example" {
  application_id = clerk_application.example.id
  name           = "app.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application this domain belongs to. Changing forces replacement.
- `name` (String) The domain name (e.g. app.example.com). Changing forces replacement.

### Optional

- `proxy_path` (String) Proxy path for the domain. Create-only; changing forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `cname_targets` (Attributes List) CNAME targets for DNS configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cname_targets))
- `frontend_api_url` (String) The frontend API URL for this domain.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the domain.
- `is_provider_domain` (Boolean) Whether this is a provider domain.
- `is_satellite` (Boolean) Whether this is a satellite domain.

<a id="nestedatt--cname_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cname_targets`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) The CNAME host.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether this CNAME record is required.
- `value` (String) The CNAME value.
